I replied to Hollis in a thread in #central-random. The Door 6 gatehouse tablet freezing at Tansleigh Packaging is ticket **#88412**.

- **Source:** Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2025-07-02. He called it a Tier 2 escalation: the tablet froze when scanning BOL barcodes. Hollis is a member of that channel, so they could see it too.
- **Similar number:** In the reply I also pointed out ticket #8841, which is a different issue (Door 2 double-booking), so nobody mixes the two up in the tracker.
